'''Carrick Station''', formerly known as '''Outpost 22''', was a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It became the heart of Republic fleet operations almost overnight when an unexpected Imperial offensive forced supply lines to shift in the final months before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Thanks to the station's initial insignificance and sudden strategic value, it was renamed in honor of former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], who experienced a similarly unexpected rise to prominence during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> <ref name=":0" />

Over the years, Carrick Station underwent dramatic upgrades to its shielding, weaponry, and sensor systems.<ref name=":0" /> Carrick Station was the main staging area for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]], and was the main hub of transport [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] bearing Republic soldiers and Jedi to and from the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Jedi sanctum of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], or the war-torn world of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> It was also [[Task Force Nova]]'s headquarters.

Carrick Station was guarded at all times by a Republic fleet of a minimum of three [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]], four [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]] and a few [[Wanderer-class transport|''Wanderer''-class transports]] and another unnamed ship class. The Republic [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] was stationed at Carrick Station during the Cold War.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Its commanding officers oversaw more than 70 percent of all Republic starship operations during this period.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reason why the station was named after Carrick is not known, as [[John Jackson Miller]] claimed that the public did not know about any positive deed Zayne did beside Swoop Dueling.<ref name="JJM">{{Twitter|username=jjmfaraway|url=status/1412924532332011521|name=[[John Jackson Miller]]|date=2021-07-07|quote=The Old Republic game has a Carrick Station. As I told the designers, Zayne hadn't yet done anything positive that the public knew about, beyond swoop dueling. Sure, it might've been named for another Carrick — even one of Zayne's four sisters.<br /><br />But there's another thread... /4}}</ref>
